captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a triple-chainring road bicycle crankset. It features a central bottom-bracket shell housing a spindle, onto which two black, hollow-styled crank arms are attached at 180 degrees relative to each other. The right crank arm has a five-arm spider pattern that supports three concentric, grey, tooth-edged chainrings of increasing diameters. At the tip of each crank arm, a simplified clip-in road pedal is mounted on a stub axle, colored black with small silver/white highlights.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a triple-chainring road bicycle crankset using CadQuery. The model should include a central bottom-bracket spindle, two black hollow-styled crank arms set 180 degrees apart, three concentric grey chainrings of graduated sizes bolted to a 5-arm spider on the right crank arm, and simplified clip-in road pedals with stub axles at the end of each crank arm.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly starting with a bottom-bracket shell and spindle using cylinders. Each crank arm is built using extruded profiles with rounded ends and a central slot for the hollowed look. The right crank arm is combined with a 5-arm spider pattern generated using polar arrays. The three chainrings are modeled as thin cylinders with custom-patterned teeth along their outer circumferences. Simplified pedals are constructed from a combination of boxes and cylinders, and are attached to the crank tips. The components are organized into parts and articulated using revolute joints for the main axle and the pedal spindles.
